query:
SELECT b.id AS "id!", b.slot_no AS "slot_no!", b.hash,
                      b.block_no AS "block_no!"
               FROM block b
               WHERE b.slot_leader_id = (
                   SELECT sl.id FROM slot_leader sl
                   JOIN pool_hash ph ON ph.id = sl.pool_hash_id
                   WHERE ph.hash_raw = $1
               )
               AND b.id < $2
               ORDER BY b.id DESC
               LIMIT $3
